name: Do I need a real estate agent for a pre-construction condo purchase?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a real estate agent for a pre-construction condo purchase?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's not strictly required, working with a real estate agent like Kelby Contreras for a pre-construction condo purchase is highly beneficial. An agent represents your interests, not the developer's, and can help you navigate complex contracts, understand market values, and negotiate terms. They also have access to information on new projects and exclusive offerings not always available to the public. Kelby Contreras specifically provides expertise in developments across Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, and Orange Counties.
acceptedAnswer.description: It is highly beneficial to use a real estate agent for a pre-construction condo purchase. An agent represents your interests, navigates contracts, and provides market insights.
